kinematics.drive: Two-axis root cardan, one positive crease drive, controlled winch/brake. Payout does not push a petal upward.
kinematics.newShapeAcknowledged: Open 60mm hinge slots, neck and terminal service cut are real static cuts; no resizing. The smooth flex shape is not silently substituted.

sequence.nominalMotion: Prescribed; not measured motor or lift speed.

cable.topology: Rigid terminal → straight tangent → supported sheave arc → helix tangent lead → supported reserve helix → anchored end on rotating drum
realJoints: Lead screw matched to groove pitch
